major_transitions.name: Anna's Arrival (First Year of Middle School)
major_transitions.trigger: Romano family moves into adjacent house
major_transitions.marker_event: Anna at window ('stoccafisso' — fixed stare behind glass)
major_transitions.perceptual_shift: recognition of hāfu difference → acceptance → celebration

major_transitions.name: Discovery of Maternal Secret (Photo in Drawer)
major_transitions.to_state: Adolescent recognition of adult secrecy and contradiction
major_transitions.trigger: Kairi searches drawer for sewing supplies and finds an envelope
major_transitions.photograph: Reira in forest, signed 'Cerbiatta' (Fawn), dated 3 years prior
emotional_sequence: Shock at discovering a non-maternal dimension of her mother
Rage at perceived betrayal of father
major_transitions.temporal_anchor: end of first year, middle of narrative

major_transitions.name: Confrontation & Parental Separation
trigger_sequence: Atsuo confirms: 'Cerbiatta' is identity, not me
Reira's rage: 'Non ti azzardare più a mettere le mani nei miei cassetti'
Physical grab; Atsuo intervenes: 'Non toccare mia figlia!'
Ultimatum: Atsuo leaves to stay with aunt
Kairi packs bag and joins father
major_transitions.dissolution_marker: Reira leaves the following day without a forwarding address

major_transitions.name: Kairi's Adolescent Autonomy Assertion
activating_moments: Learning to use washing machine with Anna's help
major_transitions.perceptual_shift: from perceived wildness and shame toward capability and self-worth
major_transitions.linguistic_marker: 'io mi voglio bene. Mi voglio tenere stretta.'

major_transitions.name: Romantic Awakening (Ryuji by the Sea)
major_transitions.moment: Ryuji's neck and collarbone detail registered
major_transitions.sensory_anchor: hand touch while entering water; 'peccato che le vacanze siano così corte'
major_transitions.consequence: epistolary correspondence begins through the seasons
major_transitions.significance: adolescent desire emerges alongside an increasing sense of autonomy

major_transitions.name: Friendship Crisis & Reconciliation (Yuki Jealousy)
major_transitions.trigger: Anna overhears Yuki telling Kairi she is more mature than Nanami
major_transitions.Anna's fear: mother prefers Kairi and may be 'stolen'
major_transitions.resolution_vector: Kairi's grandmother's perspective: Nanami is human and has varied feelings like everyone else
major_transitions.repair: Kairi bakes dorayaki; Anna bakes pastafrolla; reconciliation through food
major_transitions.lesson_encoded: love requires ongoing choice rather than assumption

cross_layer_effects.weather_correlation: major transitions align with seasonal thresholds, including winter → spring and autumn → new year
cross_layer_effects.propagation_mode: each transition reframes earlier scenes and opens new narrative possibilities forward
cross_layer_effects.stability_impact: transitions establish persistent changes in character relationships and narrative configuration
